witness_2_resolveCanvasColor_missing.after: Shipped src/composables/glass/canvas2d/resolveCanvasColor.ts (a sibling file — RATIFY 1 default, single-concern). A pure CPU probe-span resolver: appends a TRANSIENT inert <span> into the cascade at `el`, sets its color to the candidate (a bare --token is wrapped as var(--token); a light-dark()/color-mix()/var() value passes through), reads getComputedStyle(probe).color (the concrete rgb()/rgba()), removes the probe. Token READER — never mutates `el`'s own inline style (slice-28 boundary). SSR/no-DOM -> returns the input unchanged (befitting-silent, no throw).

resolveCanvasColor paints the RESOLVED color, not black: a 2D surface whose stroke reads a light-dark() token through resolveCanvasColor paints the resolved hue in BOTH light and dark (the token flips), NOT the silent-rejected black/transparent. The W30 cardinal-defect class proven FIXED at the library layer.
